title: Censored Heteroscedastic Extremes
summary: We study estimation of tail heterogeneity for non-identically distributed extreme observations subject to random right-censoring. In the uncensored setting, such heterogeneity is described by the event scedasis function, which measures the relative contribution of different design points to the upper tail. Under censoring, however, the observed tail heterogeneity is contaminated by the censoring scedasis functions, and applying uncensored techniques targets the wrong object.
